item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. No specifics needed here — just the basics: take what's scheduled, on time, as prescribed. Don't wing it, don't skip because you feel fine, don't double up because you forgot. It's one small, boring habit that keeps everything else you're building today possible. Action: set a check right now, confirm today's doses are done or scheduled, then move on.
